equations.notation: V_C cell volume; A surface area; B cooling rate; R gas constant; DeltaH_f molar heat of fusion; V_b osmotic inactive volume; V_s solute volume; nu_w and nu_s partial molar volumes; n_s intracellular salt amount; T_R=273.15 K; L_pg permeability at T_R; E_Lp activation energy.
equations.qualification: Equation 1 is transcribed from the publisher PDF equation graphic; the archived XML preserves the same equation as an image reference. Confirm transcription against the page image before production calibration.

minimally_reproducible_benchmark.cell_preparation: HeLa cells cultured in 90% DMEM + 10% FBS, 100 U/L penicillin G and 100 U/L streptomycin; washed twice with 1x PBS, trypsinized 5 min in 2 mL trypsin, centrifuged 100 x g for 5 min, resuspended in 1x PBS.
minimally_reproducible_benchmark.protocol: Place a 10 uL cell suspension drop between coverslips; cool from room temperature to -1 C at 10 C/min to seed extracellular ice with copper wire; warm to -0.5 C at 10 C/min; equilibrate 3 min; cool to target at each specified rate.
minimally_reproducible_benchmark.observable: Equivalent spherical cell radius from segmented projected area, converted to cell volume; normalize volume to the post-seeding -0.5 C equilibrium value.
minimally_reproducible_benchmark.fit: Fit the water-transport model jointly (pooled) to volume-versus-temperature observations across five cooling rates; report L_pg, E_Lp, V_b and fit R2.
minimally_reproducible_benchmark.reference_curve_data: No machine-readable volume-versus-temperature table was found in the archived article. Figure 3 provides plotted mean curves and fitted curves; digitization would be a separate, explicitly labeled derived dataset.

missing_data_and_limits: The article does not provide a machine-readable numerical reference curve in the archived full text; do not invent digitized points.
The benchmark is HeLa in PBS and measures freezing dehydration, not CPA loading/unloading or biological recovery.
The water-only membrane assumption excludes CPA and salt transport; the paper's PIF extension adds additional assumptions and fitted parameters.
Initial post-ice-seeding dehydration and incomplete extracellular-ice melting are acknowledged by the authors; the 3-minute equilibration is not guaranteed complete.
The reported fit is pooled across cooling rates and selected spherical cells (n>=28 per rate), so it is not an independent validation set.

Cell radius, intracellular salt amount, osmotic inactive volume, solution nonideality and temperature-dependent material properties require explicit calibration before reuse for another cell type or CPA.
